# An excerpt of the board trace of gl_test case 113 (cubemap) on the NanoPC-T6,
# for the frame builder's cube-map texture proof (src/mali/frame_tex_tests.rs
# `a_cube_map_s_texture_is_the_board_s`): the command-stream words of the
# first draw (face 0, level 0), the buffer of the shader program descriptors
# and the cube's 30 planes (face-major, level-minor, at 0x80), and the buffer
# of the draw's descriptors (the vertex resource table, its sampler at 0x1c0
# and the cube texture descriptor at 0x1a0).
#
# Board: NanoPC-T6 (RK3588, Mali-G610, GPU_ID 0xa8670005), Armbian,
# Linux 6.18.55-current-rockchip64, panthor, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1.
# The program: driver/tools/pvrlab/gl_test.c case 113 (a 16x16 RGBA8 cube
# map of 5 levels on each of the six faces, NEAREST_MIPMAP_NEAREST,
# CLAMP_TO_EDGE, sampled by tools/shaders/es100/cubemap.vert's
# textureCubeLod; 30 draws, one a face and level, the same descriptors in
# each), recorded on 2026-10-20 as
# 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-20-mesa-refs/mesa/mesa-cubemap.pandecode.xz
# (docs/notes/mali-cube-textures.md reads it), cut from the decompressed file
# by tools/mali/board_dump_cut.py <dump> cubemap 7fffffffd000 7ffffffcb000:
#   cubemap: mesa-cubemap.pandecode sha256 fa33bbde752dfbbae6566fa381ce7b581f200a0faf84315d851f2c1f973ab02c
# Each block is headed by its line range in the full file.
